constraints.description: Exactly eleven dependency-ordered guides and four compatibility pages exist with classified source records, current authorities, frontmatter, required concepts, and resolvable links.

validation.validation_method: Security/operations manifest validation plus missing-guide and unclassified-source negative controls

constraints.description: Authentication, provider credentials, and verified tenant construction remain distinct, and tenancy is limited to the current A2A task/context partition.

validation.validation_method: Current-source review plus unsafe-credential, unverified-identity, and blanket-isolation negative controls

constraints.description: Cedar profile coverage, empty-policy denial, the permit-all load-error fallback, final denial, approval timeout, cancellation, and channel-close outcomes are explicit.

validation.validation_method: Governance source review plus universal-fail-closed, approval-override, and timeout negative controls

constraints.description: Runtime projections, observability, realtime, cost, billing, shutdown, persistence ownership, and functional restore proof remain separate and profile-bounded.

validation.validation_method: State-owner and profile review plus durable-realtime, authoritative-billing, deadline, and read-back negative controls

constraints.description: Public material is sanitized, diagrams have prose equivalents, and local source verification makes no build, browser, deployment, runtime-security, restore, or cross-profile claim.

validation.validation_method: Private-excerpt, structure, TypeScript, brand, architecture, product, security, and composed publication controls

global_rules: Treat the OpenSpec change and security/operations manifest as the publication authority.
Run routine verification locally; GitHub Actions remain deployment-only.
Do not run the phase-level build or browser certification before all documentation content is complete.
Do not infer runtime security, restore success, or cross-profile readiness from documentation-source evidence.
termination_conditions: All five blocking content constraints have observed evidence.
Every isolated negative control fails for its intended defect before the complete fixture passes.
Strict OpenSpec and both refiner schemas pass.
The review explicitly states its build, browser, deployment, runtime-security, restore, and cross-profile evidence limits.
